blocks.text: You can back up and restore a set of policies and configuration settings, and save up to 12 restore points. If the number of restore points reaches a limit of 12, you cannot add a new restore point manually without deleting an existing one. To learn more, see About Backup and Restore.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Backup and Restore > Internet & SaaS.

blocks.text: The Add Restore Point window appears.

blocks.item: In the Add Restore Point window:
Restore Point Name: Enter a name to identify the restore point.
Golden Restore Point: Enable this option if you want to set the restore point as the Golden Restore Point.

blocks.text: There can be only one golden restore point at any given point in time, and you cannot delete it.

blocks.item: Description: (Optional) Enter additional notes or information.
Click Save and activate the change.
